name: Hazel's Nocturne

assumptions: Node B (`move`, self, stack→gy) is the spell's own default post-resolution resting zone — the ordinary "instant goes to graveyard after resolving" — not a printed clause, so it's omitted from the rules text rather than rendered as text.

couldNotDerive: Whether any keyword abilities, flavor text, or supertype/rarity apply — nothing in the nodes or self registry indicates any of these.
